content: Desktops-shrink wave + 2 owner rules (2026-11-25): (1) AESTHETIC config always MERGES into shared files, FUNCTIONAL config stays separate (per-variant/tool) — applied: regreet.toml = ONE shared file in greetd-config (DejaVu for both, no timezone key: regreet sample 'Remove to use the system time zone'); (2) /home/skem static configs = SKEL-shippable (packages install BEFORE user creation — adduser copies skel — future users inherit; /etc/xdg = true global layer for mimeapps/terminals). dinit-conditional settings.json stays installer. greetd-config 0.2.0 = regreet + post-install greeter provisioning; dms-config 0.3.0 = base.kdl + /etc/xdg defaults + PAM takeover; wayle-config 0.1.5 = PAM takeover + skel; feralos-reboot standalone. FHS: /usr/share/<app>/ for the config bases.
